title: pinalia capitellata
intro: Pinalia capitellata, commonly known as the White Cinnamon Orchid, is a type of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in Southeast Asian countries for its health benefits. The health benefits of Pinalia capitellata include its use in treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues, with its therapeutic actions attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pinalia capitellata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
